utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. Tell me what’s left, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What supplies are still missing, and do we have enough for the repairs already?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, I can help with the Sunday repair drive at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — point me to what’s left, and I’ll take a task.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli — Sunday at the community center works, and any little help is appreciated. If you can check what still needs doing, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll check what still needs doing and keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check what still needs doing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I can also check what supplies we already have while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — Sunday at the community center now. If we can keep the drop-off times and parts clearly labeled, that should help avoid mix-ups.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll make sure the drop-off times and parts are labeled clearly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks for the update — I’ll check what repair supplies we already have and what we still need for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll keep it low-key and pass along that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I can bring my tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’d only heard bits and pieces, so I’m glad it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — what’s left on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit behind on what’s been handled, so there’s probably a pile of tasks left.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center—much easier for everyone to swing by. Folks are still dropping off tools and spare parts, so it’s shaping up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great news — Sunday at the community center should make it much easier for families to stop by. I’ll keep sharing the updated details and help make sure folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the Sunday repair drive at the community center and see if I can line up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn. Just let me know if the list changes, and I’ll keep an eye out for the setup at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I still need to check what’s left on the repair drive list, so I’m not sure what’s still needed yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So we’re still waiting on the list, then? Just let me know once you’ve checked what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep the repair drive low-key and make sure we stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check what supplies we still need and confirm the repair drive is set up Sunday at the community center.
